name: Sovereign / State-Owned Counterparty View
description: Reflects how a sovereign, central bank, or state-owned entity's counsel would weigh two clauses this tool's built-in view calls neutral, specifically because of immunity and asset-title concerns that don't apply to an ordinary corporate counterparty: keeping dispute resolution in a home-jurisdiction seat rather than a foreign court, and keeping legal title to posted collateral (a pledge) rather than transferring it outright.
